reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 03, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: Dark side-parted combed-back hair, a high receding hairline and dark eyebrows remain. Two round spectacle rims joined by a thin bridge are present; the face is clean-shaven with no moustache or beard and has one restrained closed mouth. The near-frontal direct gaze, formal shoulders, chest-up crop and soft frontal facial light remain. The black formal jacket, white pointed collar and single black bow tie are retained. The rounded chin sits directly above a short broad collar transition; the bow tie is reseated naturally beneath the chin, with no elongated yellow neck column, lowered bow tie, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with two upper gray mark rows and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The 65x67 source does not resolve microscopic spectacle hardware or readable note text; the visible pair of round rims, bridge and two compact upper gray mark rows were checked without claiming exact tiny-hardware or text identity.
